<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<int> l(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> l[i];
    }
    int n1 = n / 2;
    int n2 = n - n1; // n/2 + n%2
    vector<int> first(l.begin(), l.begin() + n1);
    vector<int> sec(l.begin() + n1, l.end());
    int t1 = 1 << n1;
    int t2 = 1 << n2;
    vector<int> s1, s2;
    s1.reserve(t1);
    s2.reserve(t2);
    for (int i = 0; i < t1; ++i) {
        long long now = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n1; ++j) {
            if (i & (1 << j)) {
                now += first[j];
            }
        }
        s1.push_back(now % m);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < t2; ++i) {
        long long now = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n2; ++j) {
            if (i & (1 << j)) {
                now += sec[j];
            }
        }
        s2.push_back(now % m);
    }
    sort(s1.begin(), s1.end());
    sort(s2.begin(), s2.end());
    int maxi = 0;
    // binary search: largest element < x in sorted vector
    auto check = [&](const vector<int>& l, int x) -> int {
        int lo = 0, hi = (int)l.size() - 1;
        int ans = 0;
        while (lo <= hi) {
            int mi = (lo + hi) >> 1;
            if (l[mi] < x) {
                ans = l[mi];
                lo = mi + 1;
            } else {
                hi = mi - 1;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    };
    for (int val : s1) {
        int req = m - val;
        int pair = check(s2, req);
        maxi = max(maxi, (val + pair) % m);
    }
    cout << maxi << endl;
    return 0;
}
